M01.constraint: The NoticeTitle field must contain no more than 20 characters.

M02.constraint: The notice body must end with the exact text [Adoption Guidance].
M02.expect: Nori is ready for a calm home. [Adoption Guidance]

M03.constraint: The photo attachment value must be exactly three comma-separated animal-photo IDs.

M04.constraint: The adoption fee must include the CNY currency prefix.

M05.constraint: The notice must quote the veterinary-record sentence exactly.
M05.expect: Veterinary record: "Vaccinated, microchipped, and cleared for adoption."

M06.constraint: The NoticeText field must be written in Simplified Chinese.

M08.constraint: The notice must contain the exact action Request an adoption appointment.
